posts.author: pawsplay
posts.body:
So, maybe it's a kind of nurse thingie, even though the MV generator treats it a Male accessory. Cross-dressing healers only?
It does look like of like some Chinese-Japanese scholar hats, but it's much less elaborate and doesn't have a skullcap or ribbon. It's positioned as though it's a tokin, but it's nothing like it otherwise.
Maybe it's a kind of made-up combination tokin/nurse bonnet/miter. But I really feel like someone who is Japanese could tell me what it's supposed to be. Surely it's not a design completely original to RPG Maker.
EDIT: Actor 2_3 is also wearing a gown that appears in the Male set, I don't think this is supposed to be  nurse, but some kind of cleric.
